research_note: Selected for this session after checking primary source pages. Connections are editorial judgments, not speaker endorsements. Books, papers, and recordings were not reviewed in full; listing checks and access limits are noted below. Additions checked 2026-10-17; earlier entries retain their individual source dates.

resources.title: Designing an algorithmic cloud infrastructure provisioning system
resources.why: Read how the speaker connects application analysis, infrastructure dependencies, and deployment constraints.
resources.caveat: A dated architecture article; product behavior may have changed.

resources.title: Encore for Rust
resources.why: See how the announced Rust integration expresses application resource requirements in code.
resources.caveat: The article is published, but describes a pre-beta preview; it does not establish general availability.

resources.title: Why I Needed Rust: Finally, Infrastructure Automation I can sleep on
resources.why: Compare another engineer's use of type safety to address drift and failed infrastructure deployments.
resources.caveat: Programme checked; a recording was not verified.

resources.title: From Scripts to Contracts: what Rust's type system taught me about infrastructure composition
resources.why: Explore an announced design for typed deployment composition, recovery, and agent access to infrastructure.
resources.caveat: Future session; the abstract's system guarantees have not been independently evaluated.

resources.title: Challenges with async/await in the control plane
resources.why: Compare compile-time infrastructure checks with async cancellation problems observed in a running control plane.
resources.caveat: Company-specific experience; not a universal verdict on async Rust. Article sections reviewed; code and reported measurements were not reproduced.

resources.title: Anvil: Verifying Liveness of Cluster Management Controllers
resources.why: Compare compilation-time checks with research on verifying that Rust controllers eventually reconcile infrastructure to a desired state.
resources.caveat: OSDI 2024; abstract and media index reviewed, not controller execution or proof reproduction.
